description: The live deadline clock after a cheque bounce in India under s.138 Negotiable Instruments Act: when the demand notice must go, when the drawer's 15 days run out, and the last day to file the complaint.

cheque_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. The date written on the cheque

memo_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. The bank return memo date

notice_received_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. When the drawer received the notice, if known

notice_sent.description: Has the written demand notice gone to the drawer?

presentation_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. When the cheque was deposited (needed to detect a stale cheque)

name: cheque_bounce_timer
title: Cheque bounce (s.138) timeline
